name: Pokémon HeartGold & SoulSilver
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. First-battle teams for Pokémon HeartGold/SoulSilver: 8 Johto gyms, 8 Kanto gyms, Elite Four, Champion Lance, and Red at Mt. Silver (order 220, cap 88). Kanto gym order follows the standard progression (Brock first, Blue last). Erika's first-battle team has Tangela Lv 52 (Tangrowth is her rematch). Blue's ace is Pidgeot Lv 60. Rematch teams not included.
